skill.description: Build polished frontend experiences with responsive layouts, motion systems, conversion copy, generative art, and MiniMax-generated image, video, speech, or music assets.
skill.summary: Create production-focused frontend pages with coordinated design, motion, copy, and generated media.
skill.author: MiniMax-AI

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives from Markdown, license text, normal media writes, and documented MiniMax API access. Confirmed risks include terminal key disclosure, unrestricted lyrics-file upload, and bearer credentials sent to an unvalidated API base.

remediation.suggestion: Replace the echo command with a presence check that reports only whether MINIMAX_API_KEY is set.

remediation.issue: The music CLI accepts any lyrics file path.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict reads to the project directory and require explicit confirmation before sending file contents to MiniMax.

remediation.issue: The API base accepts any destination.
remediation.suggestion: Allowlist HTTPS MiniMax hostnames, reject embedded credentials and redirects, and require confirmation for custom endpoints.

Scaffold the project and build each section following Design and Motion rules. Integrate generated a
- **DEPENDENCY VERIFICATION:** Check `package.json` before importing any library. Output install com
- **Framework:** React/Next.js. Default to Server Components. Interactive components must be isolate
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS. Check version in `package.json` — NEVER mix v3/v4 syntax.
- **Viewport:** Use `min-h-[100dvh]` not `h-screen`. Use CSS Grid not flex percentage math.
| Typography | Headlines: `text-4xl md:text-6xl tracking-tighter`. Body: `text-base leading-relaxed
| Cards | **NEVER** use generic cards when DENSITY > 7. Use `border-t`, `divide-y`, or spacing. |
| States | **ALWAYS** implement: Loading (skeleton), Empty, Error, Tactile feedback (`scale-[0.98]`)
| Forms | Label above input. Error below. `gap-2` for input blocks. |
- **Magnetic Buttons:** Use `useMotionValue`/`useTransform` — never `useState` for continuous animat
- **Animation:** Spring physics (`stiffness: 100, damping: 20`), infinite loops, `React.memo` isolat
- Perpetual animations MUST be in `React.memo` leaf components
- `contain: layout style paint` on heavy containers
- ALWAYS provide visible focus rings (use `outline` not `box-shadow`)
- ALWAYS add `aria-live="polite"` for dynamically revealed content
- [ ] Mobile layout collapse (`w-full`, `px-4`) for high-variance designs
- [ ] **No placeholder URLs** — grep the output for `unsplash`, `picsum`, `placeholder`, `placehold`

content.value_statement: Frontend projects often need coordinated design, motion, media, and copy. This skill provides one workflow for building and refining complete experiences.
actual_capabilities: Plans responsive page structure for HTML and major component frameworks.
Provides Framer Motion, GSAP, CSS, and Three.js animation guidance.
Generates images, video, speech, and music through included MiniMax scripts.
Drafts landing-page copy with AIDA, PAS, and FAB frameworks.
Creates static or interactive generative art using bundled fonts and p5.js templates.
limitations: MiniMax media generation requires a valid API key, configured endpoint, network access, and available account balance.
Generated media may require review for quality, rights, safety, and brand compliance.
Framework dependencies are not bundled and may require separate installation.
The skill does not replace browser testing, accessibility audits, or production security review.

use_cases.title: Launch a Product Page
use_cases.description: Create responsive sections, focused copy, local media, and restrained motion for a new offer.

use_cases.title: Upgrade an Interface
use_cases.description: Refine component structure, interaction states, performance, and accessibility in an existing frontend.

use_cases.title: Produce Campaign Media
use_cases.description: Coordinate page visuals, short video, narration, music, and conversion copy for a campaign.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Simple Landing Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a responsive landing page for [product]. Include a hero, benefits, proof, pricing, FAQ, and clear calls to action.

prompt_templates.title: Refresh an Existing Frontend
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this [framework] project. Improve layout, typography, states, mobile behavior, and accessibility while preserving current features and brand constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Motion System
prompt_templates.prompt: Design motion for [page]. Choose suitable tools, define reduced-motion behavior, isolate expensive effects, and verify cleanup and mobile performance.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Multimedia Experience
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an immersive [campaign or product] experience using local generated media, conversion copy, responsive components, cinematic motion, and documented quality checks.

output_examples.input: Build a launch page for a privacy-focused team calendar.
output_examples.output: A responsive product page with clear scheduling benefits, trust-focused proof, pricing, FAQ, loading states, and subtle section reveals.

output_examples.input: Create an animated portfolio for a motion designer.
output: An asymmetric portfolio layout with project media and focused case-study copy.
Reduced-motion alternatives, lazy-loaded animation tools, and mobile interaction adjustments.
Locally stored visual assets with descriptive filenames.

output_examples.input: Design interactive generative artwork for a music event.
output_examples.output: A self-contained p5.js experience with seeded variations, event controls, responsive rendering, and a matching visual philosophy.

best_practices: Confirm media prompts, destination paths, provider endpoints, and expected costs before generation.
Verify installed dependencies and existing framework conventions before changing project structure.
Test responsive states, keyboard access, reduced motion, loading behavior, and asset availability before delivery.
anti_patterns: Do not expose API keys in commands, logs, screenshots, generated files, or troubleshooting output.
Do not upload local file contents without checking scope and obtaining explicit user approval.
Do not combine heavy animation libraries in one component or ignore reduced-motion preferences.

faq.question: Which frontend frameworks are supported?
faq.answer: The guidance covers plain HTML, React, Next.js, Vue, Nuxt, Svelte, SvelteKit, and Astro.

faq.question: Does media generation require MiniMax?
faq.answer: Yes. Included scripts call MiniMax APIs and require a valid key, trusted endpoint, network access, and account capacity.

faq.question: Can it work with an existing project?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the repository and constraints so the skill can follow current dependencies, components, styling, and brand rules.

faq.question: Does it support accessible motion?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow requires reduced-motion handling, visible focus states, pause controls, mobile fallbacks, and animation cleanup.

faq.question: Can it create generative art?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes p5.js templates, seeded randomness guidance, bundled fonts, and workflows for static or interactive output.

faq.question: What should I review before publishing?
faq.answer: Review generated media rights, copy claims, accessibility, responsive behavior, performance, endpoint trust, secrets handling, and production security.
